meta.note: The sheet's WELDING-EXTRA column reads 'assembly-extra' (e.g. 1200-600): the first number is the full hose assembly charge, the second is the welding-extra charge. Welding Extra is an OPTIONAL additional labour charge for hose jobs that need welding work — billed as its own line, never merged into technical or crimping charges. LKR.
